newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Tyrolean Air reports Q1 pretax profit.
newsitem.headline: Tyrolean Air reports Q1 pretax profit.

text.p: Austrian regional air carrier Tyrolean Airways said on Friday it had turned to a pretax profit of 79.2 million schillings in the first quarter from a loss of 35.9 million in the same period a year ago.
The company traced the improvement to cost savings, higher yield factors and the stronger dollar.
In a statement, the company said passenger volumes in the first three months rose 3.8 percent to 338,900, while the average passenger yield factor stood at 47.3 percent.
Tyrolean is 42.85 percent owned by flag-carrier Austrian Airlines. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
